title: Fleet Vol 1: three tested skills for coding agents

skills.name: pwsh-for-bash-writers
skills.credit: Rewritten, shortened and tested from the PowerShell documentation: MicrosoftDocs/PowerShell-Docs (CC-BY-4.0 text, MIT code samples), read 2026-10-04, commit a3de8f2. Every example in the skill was run in PowerShell 7.

skills.name: real-browser-automation
skills.credit: Ideas only, no text or code copied, from microsoft/playwright docs (Apache-2.0, tag v1.63.0, commit 1b025d7, read 2026-10-04). Every protocol method, event and parameter name was checked against ChromeDevTools/devtools-protocol (BSD-3-Clause, commit d209a9a, read 2026-10-04). scripts/cdp.mjs is original work.
